mapping.summary: Estonian e-invoicing via local operators, sending sales invoices and creating purchase invoices.
claims: Connects online to Estonian e-document operators Finbite, Unifiedpost and RIK
Supports the Estonian e-invoice standard with all supported operators
Supports the EU e-invoice standard where the operator does
Can reach international customers over PEPPOL and other roaming channels via the operator
Handles both sales invoices and service invoices
Sends e-invoices automatically on posting based on customer document sending profiles
PDF attachments can travel inside the e-invoice in both directions
Incoming e-invoices can be imported manually from an XML file
Creates new vendors, vendor bank accounts and items from incoming e-invoices
Maps invoice line text to G/L accounts when building purchase invoices
Finds items for invoice lines by EAN/GTIN or item number
Groups e-invoice lines by description, VAT code or grouping id
Detects duplicate documents when creating invoices
